_note: How quests run (quest/, docs/QUESTS.md). Money is the economy's (data/economy.json quests: a quest's reward); these say how much of it a run earns, how medals are set, and each quest type's own rules. Placeholder values: balancing is Phase 4 Step 5.

start._note: countdown: seconds of 3-2-1 before GO. A standing start holds the car until GO; throttle past jumpThrottle within jumpWindow seconds before GO is a jump start, jumpPenalty seconds on the time. A rolling start puts the car rollingDistance m behind the start line at rollingKmh, the clock starting as it crosses the line.

restart._note: free: restarting doesn't charge the entry fee again

wreck._note: seconds the car must have been undrivable (data/damage.json drivable) before the quest ends as Wrecked

medals._note: Times: the route's reference time (a test drive's, else its estimate for the starter car) × these; at most that long for the medal. A quest can set its own (params.medalTimes / params.medalScores).

rewards._note: Of the quest's reward (economy): each medal tier pays up to its share the first time it's reached (a higher one: the difference); finishing without a medal pays finish once; any later run that reaches nothing new pays repeat. xp: every finished run earns the quest's xp × the share for what it reached (medal, or finish) — the first time it reaches that, in full; after that, × xp.repeat. Both lose the anti-farming cut (data/economy.json quests.farming) when a quest is run again and again.

race._note: Races against NPCs (Phase 4 Step 4): the place is the medal (medalByPlace: 1st gold, 2nd silver, 3rd bronze), paid once per tier as above; a place below them pays the finish share once, then the repeat — each × placeShare for that place (1st, 2nd, …). A DNF pays nothing. Pink slips pay no money: the winner takes the loser's car.

drift._note: quest/drift.js. A drift: the car's slip angle (between where it points and where it goes) over minAngle at over minKmh. Points a second: pointsPerSecond × (angle / 30°, at most 2) × (speed / 60 km/h, at most 2). Points go into the combo pot. Every comboEvery s of drifting the multiplier goes up by one (to comboMax). A new drift within comboGrace s of the last keeps the combo going; otherwise the pot × the multiplier is banked into the score. A wall hit (a crash harder than wallHit: its strength, the closing speed in m/s, as physics/impacts.js gives it) or spinning out (angle past spinAngle) loses the pot and ends the combo.

delivery._note: The cargo takes the damage the car takes: cargo condition = 100 − car damage taken (the drop in its overall condition, %) × (fragile ? fragileFactor : 1). The payout loses the quest's damagePenalty × the share of the cargo lost. At 0% the cargo is destroyed: failed.

validation._note: A result faster than the route allows is impossible: each stretch at least its length at the car's top speed × topSpeedSlack (a little in hand for tows and downhills).

recording._note: The best run kept for ghost replays: the car's state every 1/hz s of simulated time, delta-coded.

levels._note: A player's level from their xp: reaching level L takes base × ((L − 1) + growth × (L − 1)(L − 2) / 2) xp in all, so each level takes a little more than the last; at most max. Quest tiers unlock by level (data/economy.json quests.tiers).

hud._note: the race HUD's defaults (the player can scale or hide it in settings)

difficulty._note: quest/difficulty.js. A quest's difficulty (1–5 stars) from points: each feature of its route (route/stats.js routeFeatures) — and its rivals and how tight its gold medal is — scores its value / full (at most 1) × weight, and the total's stars are how many of the thresholds it reaches, plus one. length: km of driving (laps too); corners: per km; sharpness: the corners' sharpness per km (25 m / radius × angle / 90°, each at most 1); hairpins: how many; elevation: m up and down per km; grade: the steepest, %; narrow: share on roads under 6 m; junctions: per km; exposure: share of it where there's a drop and no rail (measured in a loaded world, else not counted); rivals: NPCs × their skill; rivalSkill: the rivals' best skill; medal: how far under the starter car's estimated time gold is (0 at estimate × medal.from, full at × medal.to); byType: points a type adds. recommended: the car performance rating (garage/rating.js) a quest of each star count asks for, kept inside the quest's class (the highest it lets in) — warnBelow: the card warns if the player's car is under that share of it.

finding._note: Finding quests (quest/finder.js). notice: while free roaming, a small notice when passing within radiusM of a quest not yet played — at most one every everySeconds, each quest once a session, never during a quest (the player can switch them off). recommended: up to count quests near the player's level and car, within km (else anywhere baked), scored by: a quest whose tier is open and whose car the player has, its stars close to what the level suits (levelForStars: the level each star count suits), not yet completed, nearer first. suits: a car suits a quest if its rating is at least the quest's recommended × the difficulty's warnBelow and the quest lets it in.
